front: Name four guard-rails on automated decisions.
back: Change caps, exposure limits, uncertainty gates, and a kill switch. Add staged roll-out.

front: Zillow Offers lesson in one line?
back: When forecasts drive large, hard-to-reverse bets, limit exposure and let uncertainty change the decision.
